title: Three AI habits to change at home, and what to do instead
description: Copying answers, trusting unchecked facts and oversharing with a chatbot can hurt your child's learning or privacy. A safer swap for each.

title: Let the AI quiz you on your lab results. Answer first.
description: Ask an AI chatbot to quiz you on your own lab readings and answer before it replies. What the research says, the steps, and what to check.

title: One shared space for text, code, images, video and audio
description: EmbeddingGemma 2 puts text, code, images, video and audio in one 768-number space. What that changes in search, and five steps to check it yourself.

title: Gemini CLI 0.65.0 won't rewrite an untrusted repo's settings
description: From 0.65.0, Gemini CLI won't write a repo's settings file in an untrusted folder. What the fix covers, what was already true, and what to check.

title: Ollama says 128K, NVIDIA says 64K: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B context
description: Ollama says Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B has 128K of context. NVIDIA's own page says 64K. Here's what we found, and what we'd do before trusting either.

title: Tell any AI tool your syllabus topics before it quizzes you
description: Practice questions should come from your syllabus. Type your topics into any AI chatbot first and tell it to stay on that list. Three steps, any chatbot.

title: What can a Claude Code mod reach once you install it?
description: A Claude Code mod runs as you. The docs give one command that lists what it hooks, writes and sends without running it. Here is how to read it.
